assertions.statement: A LibreOffice PDF conversion uses an isolated, platform-aware font substitution profile without modifying the input or published DOCX.
On macOS with an available Songti candidate, the complete thesis PDF no longer embeds Arial Unicode MS for template body text.
The example template emits explicit black Heading 1, Heading 2, and Heading 3 styles while retaining Chinese template font names in DOCX.
